brief:
Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva condemned what he characterized as the "pain and trauma" inflicted by Israel's government in Gaza, according to Al Jazeera English. The president suggested the consequences of the conflict would extend across generations.

The remarks reflect growing international criticism of Israel's military operations in the enclave, where a humanitarian crisis has deepened since fighting began in October 2023.
dek: Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva condemned the “pain and trauma” inflicted by Israel’s government in Gaza.
title: Lula condemns Gaza trauma as generational
